```{r, message = FALSE}
library("AER")
library("wooldridge")
```

### Example 15.1

```{r}
data("mroz")
```

OLS
```{r}
summary_1 <- summary(lm(lwage ~ educ, data = mroz))
summary_1
```

*fatheduc* as IV for *educ*
```{r}
summary_2 <- summary(lm(educ ~ fatheduc, data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] != 0, ]))
summary_2
```

IV estimation
```{r}
summary_iv_1 <- summary(ivreg(lwage ~ educ | fatheduc,
                              data = mroz))
summary_iv_1
```

### Example 15.4
```{r}
data("card")

model_1 <- lm(educ ~ nearc4 + exper + expersq + black + smsa + south +
                smsa66 + reg662 + reg663 + reg664 + reg665 + reg666 +
                reg667 + reg668 + reg669,
              data = card)
summary_1 <- summary(model_1)
summary_1
```

```{r}
model_2 <- lm(lwage ~ educ + exper + expersq + black + smsa + south +
                smsa66 + reg662 + reg663 + reg664 + reg665 + reg666 +
                reg667 + reg668 + reg669,
              data = card)
summary_2 <- summary(model_2)
summary_2
```

```{r}
iv_1 <- ivreg(lwage ~ educ + exper + expersq + black + smsa + south +
                smsa66 + reg662 + reg663 + reg664 + reg665 + reg666 +
                reg667 + reg668 + reg669 |
                nearc4 + exper + expersq + black + smsa + south +
                smsa66 + reg662 + reg663 + reg664 + reg665 + reg666 +
                reg667 + reg668 + reg669,
              data = card)
summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)
summary_iv_1
```

### Example 15.5
```{r}
data("mroz")

model_1 <- lm(lwage ~ educ + exper + expersq, data = mroz)
summary_1 <- summary(model_1)
summary_1
```

```{r}
model_2a <- lm(educ ~ exper + expersq + motheduc + fatheduc,
               data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] > 0, ])
summary_2a <- summary(model_2a)
model_2b <- lm(educ ~ exper + expersq, data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] > 0, ])
summary_2b <- summary(model_2b)

anova(model_2a, model_2b)
```

```{r}
iv_1 <- ivreg(lwage ~ educ + exper + expersq |
                exper + expersq + motheduc + fatheduc,
              data = mroz)
summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)
summary_iv_1
```

#### Example 15.6
```{r}
data("wage2")

summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)
summary_iv_1
```

### Example 15.7
```{r}
data("mroz")

model_1 <- lm(lwage ~ educ + exper + expersq, data = mroz)
summary_1 <- summary(model_1)
summary_1
```

```{r}
model_2 <- lm(educ ~ exper + expersq + motheduc + fatheduc,
              data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] != 0, ])
summary_2 <- summary(model_2)

model_3 <- lm(lwage ~ educ + exper + expersq + model_2[["residuals"]],
              data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] != 0, ])
summary_3 <- summary(model_3)

summary_3
```

### Example 15.8
```{r}
data("mroz")

iv_1 <- ivreg(lwage ~ educ + exper + expersq |
                exper + expersq + motheduc + fatheduc,
              data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] != 0, ])
summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)

summary_1 <- summary(lm(iv_1[["residuals"]] ~ exper + expersq + motheduc +
                          fatheduc,
                        data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] != 0, ]))
summary_1
```

```{r}
428 * .0009
```

```{r}
iv_2 <- ivreg(lwage ~ educ + exper + expersq |
                exper + expersq + motheduc + fatheduc + huseduc,
              data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] != 0, ])
summary_iv_2 <- summary(iv_2)

summary_2 <- summary(lm(iv_2[["residuals"]] ~ exper + expersq + motheduc +
                          fatheduc + huseduc,
                        data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] != 0, ]))
summary_2
```

```{r}
428 * .0026
```

```{r}
summary_iv_2
```

### Example 15.9
```{r}
data("fertil1")

iv_1 <- ivreg(kids ~ educ + age + agesq + black + east + northcen +
                west + farm + othrural + town + smcity + y74 + y76 +
                y78 + y80 + y82 + y84 |
                meduc + feduc + age + agesq + black + east +
                northcen + west + farm + othrural + town + smcity +
                y74 + y76 + y78 + y80 + y82 + y84,
              data = fertil1)
summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)
summary_iv_1
```

```{r}
model_r <- lm(educ ~ meduc + feduc + age + agesq + black + east + northcen +
                west + farm + othrural + town + smcity + y74 + y76 + y78 +
                y80 + y82 + y84,
              data = fertil1)

model_1 <- lm(kids ~ educ + age + agesq + black + east + northcen + west +
                farm + othrural + town + smcity + y74 + y76 + y78 + y80 +
                y82 + y84 + model_r[["residuals"]],
              data = fertil1)

summary(model_1)
```

### Example 15.10
```{r}
data("jtrain")

d_lscrap <- with(jtrain, lscrap[year == 1988] - lscrap[year == 1987])
d_hrsemp <- with(jtrain, hrsemp[year == 1988] - hrsemp[year == 1987])
d_grant <- with(jtrain, grant[year == 1988] - grant[year == 1987])

summary_iv_1 <- summary(ivreg(d_lscrap ~ d_hrsemp | d_grant))
summary_iv_1
```
